Please just process the exchange for the thermostat to the black, Google Assistant compatible model.

And yes, please handle any price difference or refund through my Mastercard ending in 2478.

Let me know if you need anything else from me before moving forward—I want to make sure everything’s covered.
Yes, that’s all correct and I’ve listed everything I want to exchange from this order. Please go ahead with the thermostat exchange. Thank you!
